rule_set.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — consolidated through 2023 amendments

source.title: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 with amendments
source.publisher: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Government of India

fields.requirement: At least the applicable name/address declaration must be present.
Required for imported packages where applicable.
The common/generic name of the commodity must be declared.
Net quantity must be declared in the prescribed unit/form.
Month and year of manufacture/packing/import are required as applicable.
Best-before/use-by information is required where applicable, including where the commodity may become unfit for human consumption.
Maximum Retail Price must be declared in Indian currency and inclusive of taxes.
Unit sale price must be declared in the prescribed form, subject to applicability/exceptions.
Consumer-care contact details must be declared.
Dimensions are required for commodities where the rules make them applicable.

decision_model.verified: Declaration found with sufficient OCR/semantic evidence.
decision_model.potential_non_compliance: Applicable declaration is absent, malformed, or contradicted by strong evidence.
decision_model.review: Evidence is incomplete/ambiguous and requires manual verification.
decision_model.measurement_note: Image OCR verifies declared text; it does not prove the actual physical quantity without measurement.
